scope: Actual MatchesDeferredOwnerFrame and DeferredFrameElementsOnly methods, with explicit native player-data projection and bag/belt codec adapters.
cases: Version 2 matches the actual player-data equipment bytes alongside bag, belt and progression.
Matching bag/belt cannot hide differing equipment bytes; the corresponding exact new frame qualifies.
Missing, duplicate and noncanonical equipment fields are refused.
Version 1 retains its exact old shape and interpretation. A version 1 frame cannot carry a version 2 equipment field.
limitations: Authored only. Does not exercise native Equipment serialization, native upload provenance, actual final-file publication, per-output continuation, remote endpoints or dedicated topology. No game or production build is performed by this fixture.
